import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(10**7)

N = 250005

def qpow(a, b, P):
    ret = 1
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            ret = ret * a % P
        a = a * a % P
        b >>= 1
    return ret

def lowbit(x):
    return x & -x

n, kk, P = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())

# Precompute factorials and inverses
fac = [1] * (n + 1)
inv = [1] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % P

inv[n] = qpow(fac[n], P - 2, P)
for i in range(n, 0, -1):
    inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % P

# Initialize dp array with -1
dp = [[-1] * (1 << n) for _ in range(26)]

def dfs(cur, msk):
    if dp[cur][msk] != -1:
        return dp[cur][msk]
    if msk == 0:
        res = fac[n]
        for i in range(1, cur + 1):
            res = res * (kk - i + 1) % P
        dp[cur][msk] = res
        return res
    res = 0
    tmp = msk - lowbit(msk)
    i = tmp
    while i > 0:
        res = (res + inv[msk - i] * dfs(cur + 1, i)) % P
        i = (i - 1) & tmp
    res = (res + inv[msk] * dfs(cur + 1, 0)) % P
    dp[cur][msk] = res
    return res

ans = qpow(kk, n, P)
if n & 1:
    print(ans)
    sys.exit()

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % P
inv[n] = qpow(fac[n], P - 2, P)
for i in range(n, 0, -1):
    inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % P

# Reset dp array
for i in range(26):
    for j in range(1 << n):
        dp[i][j] = -1

ans = (ans - dfs(0, (1 << n) - 1) + P) % P
print(ans)
